prompt:
A designed desktop web admin UI screenshot, 16:9 landscape, of MultiReviewer 评审记录 as a refined Japanese high-density tool site. UI comp, not an e-commerce bazaar, not a poster.

STRUCTURE:
1. Persistent multi-row left rail packed with tiny gothic labels: MultiReviewer mark, then 仓库 / 评审记录 / 处置率 / 模型凭据 / 全局设置, 登出 at foot. Current item has a 2px utility-red tab on the left edge.
2. No large page title. A 11px header strip: 评审记录 · 近 30 天 · 总处置率 as a number you can click.
3. Main is a mosaic of hairline-ruled rectangular modules packed edge to edge, 1px #e8e8e8 borders, no shadows, no radius. Each module is one Review Run: small red corner tab if models failed; repo/PR as the module header; models as 11px rows; 2/9 已处置; time; 重跑 as a text control. First module acme/billing #14 with red tab 「1/2 失败」. Modules tile 2 columns on desktop, dense, almost no leftover whitespace.

WORLD: Japanese high-density industrial web, the crafted kind (tool, not mall). Ground #ffffff. Ink #111111. Utility red #c41a1a only on tabs and the failure mark. Compact gothic, tight leading, 11–13px. Light only. Chinese labels. Refined hairlines, optical alignment, no teal, no fat cards, no Illustrator gradients.
